title: Template Init Config
description: Configuration for `init --config`: answers for scaffolding a new package from template-typescript-node-package.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The JSON schema URI for this config file.

description.title: Package Description
description.description: A short description of the package.

authorName.title: Author Name
authorName.description: The name of the package author.

authorEmail.title: Author Email
authorEmail.description: The email address of the package author.

repoOwner.title: Repository Owner
repoOwner.description: The GitHub account (user or organization) that owns the repository.

repoName.title: Repository Name
repoName.description: The name of the GitHub repository.

licenseType.title: License Type
licenseType.description: The SPDX-style license identifier to apply to the package.

includeTidelift.title: Include Tidelift
includeTidelift.description: Whether to include Tidelift subscription references. Defaults to whether the author is Rebecca Stevens.

includeTests.title: Include Tests
includeTests.description: Whether to scaffold the test suite.

includeJsr.title: Include JSR
includeJsr.description: Whether to include JSR publishing configuration.

includeRenovate.title: Include Renovate
includeRenovate.description: Whether to include Renovate dependency automation.

includeCommitizen.title: Include Commitizen
includeCommitizen.description: Whether to include Commitizen commit tooling.

isPrivate.title: Private Package
isPrivate.description: Whether the package is private (not published to npm).
